subject: Application: Engineering Officer, Marc Darenz Masarate
notes: SEEK and council vacancies page list Engineering Officer under the graduate program, closing 3 Nov 2026. Apply by email to employment@sdrc.qld.gov.au with Vacancy Coversheet.
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Engineering Officer role based in Stanthorpe, listed on SEEK and on Council's current job vacancies page, closing at 09:00 on Tuesday 3 November 2026.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site and regional work and open to discussing relocation to Stanthorpe.

Supporting your Construction and Maintenance teams on roads, bridges, culverts, stormwater, footpaths and cycleways is the kind of graduate civil work I want to build on. I do not yet hold Working in Proximity to Traffic Awareness Parts 1 and 2, and I am ready to obtain them before commencement as the advert allows.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Could you please consider my application?

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: I am applying for the Engineering Officer role based in Stanthorpe. I saw the vacancy on SEEK and on Council's current job vacancies page, with applications closing at 09:00 on Tuesday 3 November 2026. The advert asks for applications at employment@sdrc.qld.gov.au.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, where I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and lodged Before You Dig Australia enquiries. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (2019).

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers each day, reviewed drawings and carried out site inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site and progress reports. I have not yet worked on an Australian council road or drainage crew, so I would be starting at graduate level.

I live in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site and regional work and open to discussing relocation to Stanthorpe. I do not yet hold Working in Proximity to Traffic Awareness Parts 1 and 2 and am ready to obtain them before commencement as the advert allows.
I've attached my resume and cover letter and would welcome the chance to support your Construction and Maintenance Delivery teams.
